rollups.text: Board games and tabletop role-playing interests: by 2023-05-20, the user enjoyed Ticket to Ride, Carcassonne, and Settlers of Catan; had played Forbidden Island with a group at a library and wanted to try Forbidden Desert; sought cooperative games for 2–4 players; was interested in learning Dungeons & Dragons; met Mike at a board-game café, where Mike shared D&D tips; considered buying the Starter Set and recruiting friends; and planned a beginner-friendly campaign about a curse affecting a small village, adapting Lost Mine of Phandelver and incorporating friends’ character backstories.

Aquariums and aquarium inhabitants: by 2023-05-21, the user’s community aquarium had anacharis and Java moss, and the user was considering Amazon Swords and Water Wisteria. The user also cared for a small 1-gallon aquarium for a friend’s child, containing a few guppies and plants. By 2023-05-23, the user had a former 5-gallon tank with a solitary betta named Finley and had set up a new 20-gallon community tank. On 2023-05-27, the user identified the 20-gallon freshwater community aquarium as Amazonia; it contained neon tetras, harlequin rasboras, and platies, and the user was considering additional easy-care plants, driftwood, and a Java moss trellis.

The user and family watched Project Runway together on Sundays and sometimes wanted to vary their marathons. The user frequently used a Chromecast to watch shows on the television rather than a laptop.

On 2023-05-23, the user said they attended yoga classes three times a week at a new studio near their apartment and were considering a class focused on inversions and arm balances.

The user had visited the American Museum of Natural History in New York City the previous weekend and seen a new Tyrannosaurus rex display. The user had driven to Nashville in June for a music festival and recalled stopping near Knoxville; the year was unspecified. The user was planning a 7-day trip to Paris and Rome, with a budget around $2,000, an interest in history and culture, and concern about not speaking French or Italian. The user was also considering another New York City trip and a weekend getaway to Boston, possibly flying from Washington, DC.

First 5K and possible future races: on the weekend of 2023-05-13..2023-05-14, the user completed their first 5K at Six Flags Magic Mountain’s Run for the Holidays, enjoyed the park course and a lap around Full Throttle, and felt somewhat sore afterward. On 2023-05-20, the user asked about preventing soreness in future races and was considering another 5K in a few months, with a particular interest in theme-park races. They also expressed interest in the Disney Princess Half Marathon and running through Disney parks, but did not say they had registered or begun the proposed training outline. Elapsed time from the first 5K to this discussion was about one week.

Aquarium development and water-quality concerns: by 2023-05-21, the user had a community aquarium with anacharis and Java moss and was considering Amazon Swords and Water Wisteria; they asked about beginner plant care, lighting, fertilizers, iron, temperature, and API CO2 Booster. They also cared for a 1-gallon aquarium for a friend’s child. By 2023-05-23, after about six months of learning aquarium keeping and having cycled a tank, the user had moved from a former 5-gallon tank with betta Finley to a new 20-gallon community tank and reported high nitrite, partial water changes, and uncertainty about the nitrogen cycle. They considered using beneficial bacteria from the old tank and setting up a quarantine tank. By 2023-05-27, they called the 20-gallon tank Amazonia, stocked it with neon tetras, harlequin rasboras, and platies, and still reported nitrite concerns; they were experimenting with fish foods and asked about glass algae, more plants, driftwood, and a Java moss trellis. Elapsed time from the plant-care discussion to the later Amazonia questions was six days.

Yoga practice and planned progression: on 2023-05-23, the user said they had been attending yoga three times weekly at a new studio near their apartment and felt ready for more challenging poses. They were considering an inversions and arm-balances class and planned to try recommended strength-building exercises. They had bought blocks, straps, and an eco-friendly mat two weeks earlier; the mat was working well, but they were unsure about its suitability for these poses. They decided to invest in a more expensive mat intended for inversions and arm balances, but no purchase was reported. The interest in progressing from regular classes to more advanced poses and equipment unfolded within the same day.

Food-bank volunteering and a possible church food drive: the church’s Lenten reflection series explored sacrifice and gratitude and prompted the user to reflect on their values and priorities (date unspecified). On 2023-05-22, the user said they were particularly drawn to volunteering at a food bank or pantry and planned to contact a local food bank about needs, guidelines, storage, logistics, seasonal patterns, shortages, goals, and ways to publicize its services. The user also said the church’s Easter egg hunt for children had been fun and was considering organizing a food drive during the 2024 Easter egg hunt, possibly making it annual; this remained a possibility, not a finalized plan. The user had attended a beautiful Easter Sunday service on 2023-04-17, with hymns and prayers that felt renewing and forgiving. The egg-hunt and food-drive planning was under consideration by 2024, following the 2023 interest in volunteering.

Senior software engineer role and professional development: HR emailed the user on 2023-05-22 inviting them to a promotion ceremony scheduled for 2023-05-29; on 2023-05-29, the user said they had recently been promoted to senior software engineer, were enjoying the role, and were leading junior engineers on a new project. They planned to prepare for the IEEE Computer Society Certified Software Development Professional (CSDP) exam and considered an MBA or additional certifications. They also considered building an online personal brand through a blog or YouTube channel. The promotion-email-to-ceremony period was seven days; the exact promotion date was described as recent.

Family resettlement and employment support: on 2023-05-26, the user said their family had moved from Turkey to the United States about two weeks earlier after learning their resettlement application was approved. The user described adapting to a new time zone and culture as a major change. Their husband was looking for work; the user was interested in electrical or plumbing vocational training, apprenticeships, and on-the-job training, and said they would contact a local workforce development agency. The family had two young children, and balancing training, childcare, and adjustment was challenging. The user also asked about refugee- and immigrant-focused counselling with culturally informed care and language access, saying counselling with someone who understood their refugee experiences could help. From the reported move timing, the move was approximately mid-May 2023; the exact date is unknown.

University alumni Slack group: on 2023-05-26, the user intended to start a Slack group for university alumni, first defining its purpose and target audience and then brainstorming names. They thought a private group would let alumni connect and share experiences without broadcasting publicly, liked the ideas of a posting calendar and a “Member of the Month,” and were considering separate channels for jobs, events, and general chat. No group launch was reported.

On 2023-05-27..2023-05-28, they planned to clean and condition brown leather loafers with Chamber’s Leather Milk. They also had new black leather ankle boots worn to work almost every other day and worn sneakers with thin soles. The records do not establish whether the planned loafers care was completed.

New-home living-room flooring and decor: on 2023-05-30, the user said they had just bought a new house and wanted a toddler-friendly living room. They considered several flooring types and focused on luxury vinyl tile or plank because it could be easy to clean and maintain amid toddler messes; they asked about installation and cost compared with hardwood and how to choose an option suited to their family. They also considered a coastal living-room theme but wanted to avoid overdoing it. No flooring or decor choice was reported.
